interactive.label: Open
interactive.tooltip: Open TTTR photon stream file.

interactive.label: IRF
interactive.tooltip: Load an instrument-response TTTR file.

interactive.label: Sim
interactive.tooltip: Generate a synthetic two-state exchange photon stream.

interactive.label: Run
interactive.tooltip: Build 2D-FDC and resolve lifetimes.

interactive.label: Help
interactive.tooltip: Explain what the map shows, how to read it and what to check first.

interactive.label: Guide
interactive.tooltip: Walk through the demo: simulate a stream whose answer is known, run and read the map.

interactive.label: dT_ms
interactive.tooltip: Macro-time lag dT at which the 2D fluorescence-decay correlation is built. Pick a value within the dynamics timescale to see lifetime cross-peaks.

interactive.label: ddT_ms
interactive.tooltip: Half-width of the macro-time lag window (ddT). Wider = more photon pairs but coarser lag resolution.

interactive.label: tmin_ns
interactive.tooltip: Lower micro-time gate (ns) for the decay axis.

interactive.label: tmax_ns
interactive.tooltip: Upper micro-time gate (ns) for the decay axis.

interactive.label: max_bins
interactive.tooltip: Block-rebin the 2D-FDC down to this many bins before inversion (speed vs resolution).

interactive.label: n_components
interactive.tooltip: Number of log-spaced trial lifetimes in the inversion basis.

interactive.label: tau_min_ns
interactive.tooltip: Smallest trial lifetime (ns).

interactive.label: tau_max_ns
interactive.tooltip: Largest trial lifetime (ns).

interactive.label: log10_reg
interactive.tooltip: Regularisation as log10(reg); 0 selects it automatically by L-curve.

interactive.label: irf_center_ns
interactive.tooltip: Centre (prompt position) of the synthetic IRF in ns. Ignored for Detect/File/None.

interactive.label: irf_fwhm_ns
interactive.tooltip: Full width at half maximum of the synthetic IRF (ns).

interactive.label: irf_shape
interactive.tooltip: Skewness of the synthetic IRF pulse (0 = symmetric Gaussian).

interactive.label: rise
interactive.tooltip: When running the 1D-MEM, scan the IRF rise position and average the distributions around the optimum (port of TK_MyMain_Search_RiseIRF_1DMEM); reduces the IRF-timing systematic.

interactive.label: corr
interactive.tooltip: After resolving the lifetimes, compute the species-resolved (lifetime-filtered) correlation and fit the interconversion relaxation time + rate matrix.

interactive.label: n_casc
interactive.tooltip: Multi-tau cascades for the filtered correlation.
